questions.prompt: In which year did the Titanic sink?
questions.fact: It carried lifeboats for about half those aboard, which met the regulations of the day because rules were based on tonnage.

questions.prompt: Which organ produces insulin in the human body?
questions.fact: It also secretes digestive enzymes, making it both an endocrine and an exocrine gland.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a mallet to hit a ball while riding a horse?
questions.fact: Players change horses between chukkas because the animals cannot sustain the pace for a whole match.

questions.prompt: Which film features a boy who says 'I see dead people'?
questions.fact: The director wrote the script as a straightforward thriller first, adding the twist relatively late in drafting.

questions.prompt: Which Great Lake is entirely within the United States?
questions.fact: It is hydrologically joined to Lake Huron at the Straits of Mackinac, so the two are technically one lake.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set on the fictional island of Lilliput?
questions.fact: It was written as a savage political satire, and only later repackaged as a children's adventure story.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the Chrome web browser?
questions.fact: It launched with a comic book drawn by Scott McCloud explaining its design, released a day early by accident.
